case_name: Dilip Paswan @ Dilip Kumar vs State Of Bihr Through The Secretary, ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Dilip Paswan @ Dilip Kumar (son, husband, etc.)
parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Bihr Through The Secretary, Home Department, Govt. of Bihar, Patna Bihar and others

facts_of_case: Petitioner's wife Sonali Kumari was given into custody and care of her mother by the Court below on 25.08.2021; petitioner claims their lives are in danger and seeks direction to search for, find and secure her life with child.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the informant to prove that her daughter was kidnapped.
legal_principles.held: It is claimed by the informant that on her repeated call on above phone number the call was answered by her daughter who told the informant that she had been forcibly taken by Dilip Kumar to his village Balsandi under Gaunaha police station.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not intervene in a marriage solemnized before witnesses, unless there is a prima facie case of coercion or undue influence.
legal_principles.held: The case has been instituted on false, fabricated and baseless allegations made by the informant under instigation from her relatives who disapproved of the inter-caste marriage of the petitioner Dilip Paswan with informant's daughter Sonali Dixit.
